reason: Greptile finding (PR #1687): a naturally completed sync advanced last_synced_at even when item extraction dropped rows, marking an incomplete dataset fresh. The incremental watermark now only advances when outcome.complete AND no extract/hydration failures occurred; dropped rows leave the dataset unfresh until the next clean sync.
validated_outcome: live dogfood PASS 457/457 after fix; publish validate all checks PASS
